name: tab-project
description: LogicWeaver browser extension, Vue UI islands, and Android runtime

scripts.build:bg: esbuild src/background/index.ts --bundle --outfile=generated/background.js --format=esm --target=chrome120 && esbuild src/background/index.ts --bundle --outfile=background.js --format=esm --target=chrome120 && esbuild src/workers/bookmarks.worker.ts --bundle --outfile=generated/bookmarks-worker.js --target=chrome120 && esbuild src/workers/bookmarks.worker.ts --bundle --outfile=bookmarks-worker.js --target=chrome120 && esbuild src/theme/theme-init.ts --bundle --minify --outfile=generated/theme-init.js --target=chrome120
scripts.ui:build: vite build --config vite.ui.config.ts && vite build --config vite.sandbox.config.ts && vite build --config vite.localizer.config.ts && npm run build:bg
scripts.ui:check: npm run ui:typecheck && npm run ui:build
scripts.android:add: npm run mobile:prepare && cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && cap open android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
